(Japanese: '''ゆれる島の戦い！ドジョッチVSナマズン！！''' ''Shaking Island Battle! {{tt|Dojoach|Barboach}} VS {{tt|Namazun|Whiscash}}!!'') was intended to be the 101st episode of {{aniseries|RS}}, and the 375th episode of the [[Pokémon animated series]]. It was set to air in Japan on November 4, 2004, but the episode was [[Banned episodes|skipped]] due to {{wp|2004 Chūetsu earthquake|strong earthquakes in Niigata prefecture}} nearly a week before the first airing of [[AG100]]. It has never aired in Japan or in any other country, and is thus not considered [[canon]].

Likely as a result of this episode's cancellation, the move {{m|Earthquake}}, as well as similar moves such as {{m|Fissure}} and {{m|Magnitude}}, has not been used in the animated series in any later point.

==Plot==
After winning the {{badge|Mind}} at the [[Mossdeep Gym]], {{Ash}} now heads for [[Sootopolis Gym|the final Gym]] in [[Sootopolis City]]. Along the way, he and {{ashfr}} stop by on Jojo Island and are caught in an {{m|earthquake}} caused by a group of {{p|Whiscash}}. They then meet a [[Pokémon Trainer]] named [[Chōta]] and his {{p|Barboach}}, and decide to help him in getting rid of the Whiscash.

==Trivia==
* This was the only ''[[Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire]]'' episode to be [[Banned episodes|banned]] in every country, the second episode of the entire {{pkmn|animated series}} to be banned in every country (the first being [[EP038]]), and the first regular episode of the entire animated series to never be aired at all. Two [[BW023 (unaired)|later]] [[BW024 (unaired)|episodes]] were also cancelled just before airing because of an earthquake.
** Because this episode never aired, {{Ash}} is never shown learning the location of [[Sootopolis Gym|the final Hoenn League Gym]] onscreen.
* A {{p|Whiscash}} in this episode seems to be a [[giant Pokémon]], just like [[Nero]].
